identity.summary: A merge of pre-trained language models created using mergekit.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: text-output language model merged from pretrained checkpoints with no reported factuality or grounding evaluation -> plausible hallucination risk

possible_risks.description: Determining who is responsible for an AI model is challenging without good documentation and governance processes. The use of synthetic data in model development adds further complexity, since the lack of standardized frameworks for recording synthetic data design choices and verification steps makes accountability harder to establish.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight merge of two named base models with no documentation of merge provenance, training data, or governance -> accountability harder to establish

specifications.model_size: 18.9 GiB of safetensors weights (20,318,474,544 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: This checkpoint is a merge of lemon07r/Gemma-2-Ataraxy-Advanced-9B and nbeerbower/Gemma2-Gutenberg-Doppel-9B, combined using the SLERP merge method.
